sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 66 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Exact coordinates of independently image-read controls reused only on geometrically shared mapped source sections (source centres within2m, parallel normals, along-cross-section departure<=1.5m). Original control coordinates unchanged. Original central imagery is byte-identical to the corresponding subimage of the target pinned large mosaic. These are transferred observations, not additional independent image readings. Six new edge readings at three connector cross-sections complete the western branch controls. No nominal width, inferred seed point or interpolated point is labelled observed. New independently read shortcut/connector controls: [[220,-5.5,4.5],[230,-4.7,4.6],[240,-5,4.5]] (metres along source normal, inner then outer signed offsets; null is unobserved). All roof, walkway and shared-paving joins remain estimated. No geometry/guard changes. Requested imagery grid0.3972m; sensor-native detail and capture date unknown. Approximately1m reading uncertainty is not surveyed accuracy. Road-edge offsets interpolate on source normals except the explicit shared-paving linear intervals0..20. Roof-obscured outer352..383 and pedestrian-walkway limits interpolate from visible controls; no roof edge or hidden barrier is an observation. Original trace/timing unchanged, configuration/direction draft, terrain approximate, curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
